title: Defanging an IP Address
statement: Return the defanged version of an IPv4 address by replacing each period with [.] .
explanation: A direct character replacement preserves all digits and separators except the periods.

title: Relative Sort Array
approach: Count priority values then sort the remainder
statement: Sort arr1 so values appearing in arr2 follow arr2’s order, while other values appear in ascending order at the end.
explanation: Count arr1 frequencies, emit values in arr2 order, then append the remaining values in sorted order.

title: Number of Equivalent Domino Pairs
statement: Count pairs of dominoes equivalent under swapping their two values.
explanation: Represent each domino as the ordered pair (min(a,b), max(a,b)); each new occurrence forms as many pairs as prior occurrences.

title: N-th Tribonacci Number
statement: Return Tn where T0=0, T1=T2=1, and each later term is the sum of the previous three.
explanation: Maintain the previous three terms and update them iteratively.

title: Day of the Year
statement: Return the one-based day number within the year for a date formatted YYYY-MM-DD.
explanation: Sum the days in prior months and add the day, using 29 days for February in leap years.

title: Find Words That Can Be Formed by Characters
approach: Check word counts against available characters
statement: Return the sum of lengths of words that can be formed from chars using each character no more often than it appears there.
explanation: Count available characters and include a word only if every required character frequency is available.

title: Compare Strings by Frequency of the Smallest Character
approach: Sort word frequencies and upper-bound queries
statement: For each query, count words whose frequency of their smallest character is strictly greater than the query’s corresponding frequency.
explanation: Compute each word’s smallest-character frequency, sort the list, and binary-search the first value greater than each query value.

title: Distance Between Bus Stops
statement: Given a circular route with distances between adjacent stops, return the shorter distance between start and destination.
explanation: Sum distances along one direction and return the minimum of that sum and the total minus that sum.

title: Day of the Week
statement: Return the weekday name for a valid Gregorian date in the supported year range.
explanation: Convert the date to a calendar weekday using the language’s standard date library.

title: Minimum Absolute Difference
statement: Return all pairs with the minimum absolute difference in an array, with each pair sorted and the list in ascending order.
explanation: Sort the values; the minimum difference is attained by at least one adjacent pair in sorted order.
